header.case_description: Synthetic Illinois, 60 Hz balanced three-phase EMT. 200 AC buses, 180 lines, 66 transformers and 40 synchronous machines.
header.case_comments: 100 MVA base. The lumped lines use total positive-sequence R, X and B with unit length and uncoupled phases. Each transformer assumes 0.001 pu no-load current and 20 kW core loss. Bus 197 uses two identical parallel q-axis dampers for its single effective damper. The bus 149 fault uses a 0.01 pu reactor with a switched discharge resistor.
